## R Markdown

```{r}
X <- matrix(c(3, 1, 0,
              6, 4, 6, 
              4, 2, 2, 
              7, 0, 3, 
              5, 3, 4), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

X_bar <- t(X) %*% rep(1, 5) * (1/5)
X_bar
```

```{r}
X_bar <- rep(1, 5) %*% t(X_bar)
X_c <- X - X_bar
X_c
```

```{r}

S <- (1/4) * t(X_c) %*% X_c
S
det(S)
```

```{r}
rango <- qr(X)$rank
num_vectores <- ncol(X)

# Verificación
if (rango == num_vectores) {
  cat("Son LINEALMENTE INDEPENDIENTES (Rango =", rango, ")\n")
} else {
  cat("Son LINEALMENTE DEPENDIENTES (Rango =", rango, "de", num_vectores, "vectores)\n")
}
```
